CampusRegistry.title: CampusRegistry
CampusRegistry.description: Top-level cross-device registry record for each registered campus/festival workspace stored at campus_registry/{festivalCode}.

adminPin.description: Per-event Admin PIN assigned to unlock the campus Admin Panel.

activeItemId.description: Competition item ID currently pushed live to all connected Judge Portal screens (legacy/fallback).

judgesCount.description: Configured number of judges per competition item (2 or 3).

stageLiveItems.description: Per-stage live competition item IDs (Stage 1, Stage 2, Stage 3) synced to Judge Portal devices.

chartType.description: Selected visualization chart type for Group Points & Standings.

gradeA.description: Minimum percentage threshold for Grade A.

gradeB.description: Minimum percentage threshold for Grade B.

gradeC.description: Minimum percentage threshold for Grade C.

isActive.description: Commercial license activation status (true = active, false = suspended).

expiresAt.description: Inclusive event license expiry date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the event was registered.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of latest registry update.

EventConfig.title: EventConfig
EventConfig.description: Isolated campus or festival configuration including display title, subtitle, active live item, and custom event admin PIN stored at events/{festivalCode}/settings/config.

adminPin.description: Custom event-specific Admin PIN for unlocking the campus Admin Panel.

activeItemId.description: Competition item ID currently live on stage and synced to Judge Portal devices (legacy/fallback).

judgesCount.description: Configured number of judges per competition item (2 or 3).

stageLiveItems.description: Per-stage live competition item IDs (Stage 1, Stage 2, Stage 3) synced to Judge Portal devices.

chartType.description: Admin-selected visualization chart type for Group Points & Standings.

gradeA.description: Minimum percentage threshold for Grade A (default 80, must be > gradeB and <= 100).

gradeB.description: Minimum percentage threshold for Grade B (default 70, must be > gradeC and < gradeA).

gradeC.description: Minimum percentage threshold for Grade C (default 60, must be >= 0 and < gradeB).

isActive.description: Commercial license activation status (true = active, false = suspended).

expiresAt.description: Inclusive event license expiry date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the event was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of latest config update.

StageLiveItemsMap.title: StageLiveItemsMap
StageLiveItemsMap.description: Dynamic map of active live competition item IDs keyed by configured stage name (e.g. Stage 1, Stage 2, Stage 4 - Kabani).

Stage 1.description: Active competition item ID pushed live for Stage 1.

StageSettings.title: StageSettings
StageSettings.description: Ordered list of configured parallel festival stages stored at events/{festivalCode}/settings/stages.

stages.description: Ordered array of active stage names (default ['Stage 1', 'Stage 2', 'Stage 3'], expandable dynamically).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of latest stages configuration update.

JudgeSlotConfig.title: JudgeSlotConfig
JudgeSlotConfig.description: Assigned official judge name, 4-digit access PIN, and optional stage assignment for a judge slot (J1, J2, or J3).

pin.description: 4-digit PIN required to unlock this judge slot on Judge Portal devices.

stage.description: Assigned stage name for this judge.

JudgePanelSettings.title: JudgePanelSettings
JudgePanelSettings.description: Per-stage PIN-protected judge panel assignments (J1, J2, J3) stored at events/{festivalCode}/settings/judges.

stagePanels.description: Map of stageName -> { J1, J2, J3 } independent judge panels.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of latest judge panel update.

Group.title: Group
Group.description: A house, team, or group registered within a specific festivalCode for team standings calculation.

name.description: Display name of the group or house (e.g., Red House).

color.description: Hex color code used for badges and standings charts.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the group was created.

CompetitionItem.title: CompetitionItem
CompetitionItem.description: An arts festival competition event or item scoped to a specific festivalCode.

id.description: Unique identifier for the competition item.

name.description: English name of the competition item.

malayalamName.description: Malayalam name of the competition item.

itemType.description: Whether the competition item is an Individual or Group event.

maxMarks.description: Maximum marks possible for this item (always 100).

criteria.description: 4 item-specific judging criterion labels (25 marks each).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the item was created.

Participant.title: Participant
Participant.description: A registered contestant with a chest number assigned to a competition item within a festivalCode.

name.description: Full name of the contestant or team lead.

JudgeScore.title: JudgeScore
JudgeScore.description: Score entry submitted by a judge for a specific participant in a festivalCode.

id.description: Deterministic score ID combining itemId, participantId, and judgeSlot.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of latest score update.

/campus_registry/{festivalCode}.description: Top-level real-time synchronized directory of registered campus/festival workspaces, PINs, and license metadata.

/events/{festivalCode}/settings/{setting.description: Stores isolated institution config (settingId='config'), per-stage Judge Panels (settingId='judges'), and configured Festival Stages list (settingId='stages') for a specific festivalCode.

/events/{festivalCode}/groups/{groupId}.description: Stores registered houses/teams/groups isolated to festivalCode.

/events/{festivalCode}/items/{itemId}.description: Stores competition events and items isolated to festivalCode.

/events/{festivalCode}/participants/{par.description: Stores registered participants and chest numbers isolated to festivalCode.

/events/{festivalCode}/scores/{scoreId}.description: Stores real-time judge score submissions isolated to festivalCode.
